name: Data Recipe: Daily B2B sales-signal feed (tenders + hiring)

parameters.content:
## Daily B2B sales-signal feed
Every weekday at 7:00 two Fast Data actors run in parallel: [German Public Tenders](https://apify.com/fast_data_asap/german-public-tenders-bund) (service.bund.de) and [Career Site Jobs API](https://apify.com/fast_data_asap/career-site-jobs-api) (your target companies' career sites). A Code node turns both into one signal schema with a simple score, signals already in the Google Sheets log are dropped, new ones go to the sheet and Slack.

**Setup (10 min)**
1. Both HTTP nodes: Header Auth credential `Authorization` = `Bearer <Apify API token>`.
2. Edit *Settings* (keywords, states, companies).
3. Connect Google Sheets (tab `Signals`, header row in README) in both Sheets nodes, and Slack.
4. Optional: enable *Create Pipedrive activity*.

Cost: $0.002 per tender, $0.002 per job returned.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.notes: Keywords, states and target companies. lookbackDays 0 = automatic: 4 days on Mondays (weekend), 2 days otherwise. The sheet log removes the one-day overlap.

nodes.name: Read signal log
nodes.notes: Same spreadsheet and tab as 'Log new signals'.

nodes.name: Create Pipedrive activity
nodes.notes: Example, disabled. Creates a task per high signal. Swap for HubSpot or your CRM.
